app.title: QA Management
dashboard.title: QA Execution Dashboard
dashboard.confirmReset:
Reset "{name}" to demo data?

The active project's inputs (execution counts, planning rows and name) will be replaced with demo data.
This action cannot be undone unless you have a backup.
hint.plannedFinish: Projected from team capacity and the daily plan (not from today's pace). Working days only — weekends and Japan public holidays are skipped. Daily overtime extends each day past 17:30; the deadline itself stays at 17:30.
hint.forecastFinish: Projected if today's execution pace continues until the work is done.
hint.buffer: Deadline minus the planned finish. Positive = time to spare before the deadline.
hint.scheduleVariance: Target finish time minus the forecast finish (pace-based). Positive = ahead.
hint.qaTested: Pass + Fail + N/A. Excludes cases transferred to the SPO side.
hint.qaCompleted: Pass + Fail + N/A + SPO assigned. This completed count drives the schedule.
hint.qaTestedRatio: Tested (excl. SPO) divided by total cases.
hint.qaCompletedRatio: Completed cases divided by total cases.
hint.requiredTesters: Testers needed to finish the remaining cases by the deadline.
hint.requiredHours: Pure execution time needed for the remaining cases.
hint.actualRate: Cases completed per productive hour so far today.
hint.currentRate: Cases completed per productive hour so far today.
hint.requiredRate: Pace needed to finish the remaining cases by the target finish time.
hint.capacityShortage: Cases that cannot be completed before the deadline.
hint.extraDays: Additional working days needed beyond the planned days.
hint.recommended: Testers needed across the planned days to meet the target.
hint.vsTarget: Planned completion minus the target. Positive = ahead of the target.
hint.progress: Completed cases divided by total cases.
hint.plannedProgress: Where progress should be by now at the planned pace.
hint.dailyOvertime: Extra working minutes added to every day after 17:30 — including today. The deadline comparison stays at 17:30, so overtime shows as reduced delay.
timeline.title: Timeline
whatIf.title: What-If: Tester Count
whatIf.hint: Click a row to apply that tester count
plan.staffingHint: Available = max(0, planned − absent). Weekends and Japan public holidays are automatically non-working. Work hours, lunch and per-hour rate are shared with the Input section.
plan.insertDayAfter: Insert a copy of this day after it
errors.windowOrder: End time must be after the start time.
errors.targetBeforeStart: Must be on or after Start Time
errors.lunchOrder: Lunch End must be after Lunch Start
errors.lunchWindow: Lunch must be inside the work window
errors.startAfterLunch: Plan Start Time must be at or before the lunch break start (12:00)
errors.planDateOrder: Must be after the previous row
explanation.shortage: {capacity} cases can be completed during regular working hours before the deadline. {remaining} cases remain, resulting in a shortage of {shortage} cases.
explanation.feasible: {capacity} cases can be completed during regular working hours before the deadline. All {total} cases finish by {finish}, {buffer} ahead of the deadline.
explanation.late: All {total} cases finish on {finish}, {overrun} after the deadline {deadline}.
explanation.noTarget: {capacity} cases can be completed during regular working hours across the {days} planned days. No deadline is set.
explanation.allDone: All {total} test cases are already complete.

dailyReport.confirmDeleteDraft: Delete this draft? Finalized reports are not affected.
dailyReport.popupBlocked: The print window was blocked. Allow pop-ups for this site to export as PDF.

dailyReport.jiraFallbackHint: If left empty, the project JIRA URL from Settings is used in the report.
dailyReport.deleteDraftHint: Delete this draft (finalized reports are kept)
dailyReport.morningScheduleHint: Seeded from the current plan — add, remove and reorder items freely.

exec.qaCompletedHelp: QA Completed = Pass + Fail + N/A + SPO対応 (SPO Assigned)
exec.statusesHelp: Blocked / Retest / Question (質問中) are informational open-status counts — they do not affect completion, remaining cases or the schedule.

persistence.corruptionBody: Some stored data was unreadable, so the app started from safe defaults. The original data was preserved under a local recovery key — use Import to restore a backup.
persistence.fallbackBody: The browser database is unavailable, so data is being saved to local browser storage instead. All data stays on this machine.
persistence.migrationFailedBody: The move to the browser database did not finish, so the app keeps using local browser storage. Your data was preserved and the migration will be retried on the next start.
persistence.migrationReason.invalidLocal: The saved local data did not pass validation
persistence.migrationReason.writeFailed: Writing to the browser database failed
persistence.migrationReason.verification: The database read-back did not match after writing
persistence.migrationReason.integrityFai: The workspace failed the integrity check
persistence.migrationReason.staleFallbac: The local copy is older than the last database revision
persistence.recoveryBody: The local database is unavailable. A previous local copy exists, but it may not contain your latest changes. The copy has been kept and opened as the best available data — newer data cannot be restored automatically.
persistence.recoveredBody: A newer local copy was detected and restored to the local database. Please review your data.
history.revisions.title: Revision History
history.restoreConfirm:
Restore revision {revision}?

A NEW revision will be created with the state of revision {revision}. Newer history is kept and nothing is deleted.
history.recoveryComplete: Recovery completed — revision {revision} now holds the state of revision {restoredFrom}.
history.noHistory: No revision history yet — the first committed change will appear here.
history.unavailable: Revision history is unavailable in the current storage mode.
history.preview: Preview of changes when restoring this revision
history.loadFailed: The revision history could not be read.
history.restoreFailed: The revision could not be restored.
overall.confirmDeleteProject:
Delete "{name}"?

This will remove the project and its local execution data.
This action cannot be undone unless you have a backup.
import.invalidFile: Import failed — the selected file is not a valid GanttChart backup.
import.confirmBackup: Restore this backup? All current local data (projects, reports and settings) will be replaced.
import.confirmProject: Import project "{name}" with {count} report(s)? It will be added as a new project.
import.confirmAppState: Import this project data? It will replace the data of the currently active project.
settings.autoBackupHint: Writes a full-workspace backup file automatically on the first app start of each day. The backup is the same file as the manual Export Backup.
settings.autoBackupNoFolder: No folder selected — backups are downloaded to the browser's Downloads folder.
settings.autoBackupDownloadsNote: This browser does not support choosing a folder (Chrome/Edge required). Backups are downloaded to the Downloads folder instead.
settings.autoBackupRetentionHint: The app's own dated backup files older than this are removed from the backup folder when a new one is written. Other files are never touched.
settings.autoBackupRunNowErr: The backup file could not be written.
autoBackup.needsPermissionBody: After a browser restart, the backup folder must be re-confirmed once. Your data is safe — only the automatic backup file is affected.
autoBackup.failedBody: The daily backup file could not be written. Create one manually via Reports & Export → Export Backup.
settings.dangerZoneHint: Destructive operations that cannot be undone without a backup.
settings.confirmClearAll:
Clear all local GanttChart data?

All projects, reports, planning data and local settings will be removed.
settings.holidaysLinesDropped: {count} invalid holiday lines were ignored (expected YYYY-MM-DD).
settings.clearAllDone: All local data has been cleared.
settings.clearAllAborted: Nothing was deleted: a recovery snapshot of your data could not be saved (browser storage may be full). Download a backup, free up space, then try again.
settings.storageMigrationFailed: not completed — retried on next start

performance.allocationDescription: Adjust the proposed allocation per member for a day. The attendance-aware suggestion splits the executed total among attending testers; the remainder is shown as unassigned. Edited allocations are saved as manual overrides that sync never overwrites.
performance.allocationSuggestedNone: No attending testers — verify before applying
performance.allocationNoDates: No dates with executed cases and assigned testers for the active project.

allocation.memberOverlap: {member}: completed categories ({sum}) exceed their tested total ({cases}).

review.subtitle: Objective evidence for supervisor evaluation
review.noReviews: No reviews recorded for this tester yet.
review.noData: No objective data for this tester in the selected period.
review.selectTester: Select a tester to view the review evidence.
review.disclaimer: This workspace presents objective evidence only. Bonus amounts, ratings and rankings are decided by the supervisor.
review.confirmDelete: Delete this review? The objective data is not affected.

performance.syncNoChanges: No records to create or update.
performance.syncUnassigned: Days with execution but no tester assignment: {count}
performance.confirmRemoveRecord: Remove this daily execution record? This cannot be undone.
performance.noActiveProject: No active project. Select or create a project first.
performance.attendanceAbsent: Attendance says absent ({status}), but {cases} cases are recorded.
performance.assignmentNone: No testers assigned to this project yet.
shared.status.offline: Offline — changes are kept on this device
shared.status.offlinePending: Offline — {count} change(s) will be sent when you reconnect
shared.banner.conflictTitle: Someone else changed the same data
shared.banner.conflictBody: Your edit to {count} item(s) was not applied because someone else changed them at the same time. The latest shared version is shown. Your version is kept on this device so it can be recovered.
shared.banner.readonlyBody: You can see everything and receive live updates, but changes you make are not saved to the shared workspace.
shared.banner.expiredBody: Reload the page to sign in again. Changes you made since the last sync are kept on this device and will be sent after you sign in.
shared.banner.errorTitle: The shared workspace could not save a change
shared.banner.leaveWarning: You have changes that have not been sent to the shared workspace yet.
shared.link.title: Connect to the shared workspace
shared.link.counts: {projects} project(s) · {reports} daily report(s) · {attendance} attendance record(s) · {topics} topic(s) · {members} member(s)
shared.link.createBody: Nobody has set it up yet. Create it now with a starter project; everyone you invite will then see the same data.
shared.link.initTitle: The shared workspace is empty — and this browser has data
shared.link.initBody: You can use the data already in this browser as the starting point for everyone, or start the shared workspace fresh.
shared.link.initShare: Share this browser’s data with the team
shared.link.initShareHelp: Everything in this browser is uploaded to the shared workspace. Nothing in this browser is deleted.
shared.link.initFreshHelp: Creates a new shared workspace with a starter project. This browser’s current data is saved to a backup file first and is not used.
shared.link.chooseTitle: Both this browser and the shared workspace have data
shared.link.chooseBody: Nothing has been changed yet. Choose how to connect. Nothing is overwritten unless you pick the last option and confirm it.
shared.link.useSharedHelp: Loads the shared data. The data currently in this browser is replaced here — a backup file is downloaded first. Nobody else is affected.
shared.link.mergeHelp: Adds what only this browser has to the shared workspace. If the same item exists on both sides, the shared version is kept and yours is saved on this device. Nothing shared is deleted.
shared.link.replace: Replace the shared workspace with this browser’s data
shared.link.replaceHelp: DESTRUCTIVE for everyone: the shared workspace becomes exactly what is in this browser. The previous shared data stays in History for {days} days and can be restored. SVs only.
shared.link.replaceAdminOnly: Only an SV can replace the shared workspace.
shared.link.backupNote: A backup file of this browser’s data was downloaded.
shared.link.localOnly: Work on this device only (not shared)
shared.link.unreachableBody: Check your internet connection. You can retry, or work on this device only; nothing you do in that mode is shared.
shared.link.loginBody: Your sign-in session ended. Reload the page to sign in.
shared.link.errorTitle: The shared workspace is not available
shared.link.errorBody: The server refused the request (status {status}). Ask an SV to check that sign-in protection is set up.
shared.link.failedExport: The shared workspace could not be read. Please retry.
shared.link.notAllowed: That choice is not available to you.
shared.confirm.resetProject: This resets the active project to the sample data for EVERYONE in the shared workspace. It can be restored from History for {days} days. Continue?
shared.confirm.replaceWorkspace: This replaces the WHOLE shared workspace for everyone with the contents of this file. It can be restored from History for {days} days. Type {word} to continue.
shared.error.adminOnly: Only an SV can replace the whole shared workspace.
shared.error.readOnly: You have read-only access, so this change cannot be saved.
shared.settings.clearDeviceConfirm: This clears the data stored in THIS browser and disconnects it from the shared workspace. The shared workspace and everyone else’s data are NOT affected. A backup file is downloaded first. Continue?
shared.settings.clearDeviceHelp: Removes the copy stored in this browser. The shared workspace is not touched; you can reconnect afterwards.
shared.history.title: Shared history
shared.history.help: Every change to the shared workspace is recorded for {days} days. Restoring a revision creates a NEW revision, so nothing is lost and the restore itself can be undone.
shared.history.failed: The history could not be loaded.
shared.history.adminOnly: Only an SV can restore a revision.
shared.history.previewResult: At revision {n}: {projects} project(s), {reports} daily report(s), {attendance} attendance record(s), {topics} topic(s), {members} member(s).
shared.history.restoreConfirm: Restore the whole shared workspace to revision {n} ({when})? Everyone will see the restored data. You can undo this from History.
shared.history.restoreDone: Restored. The shared workspace now matches revision {n} (new revision {rev}).
shared.history.restoreFailed: The revision could not be restored.
shared.confirm.deleteProject: This deletes the project for EVERYONE in the shared workspace. It can be restored from History for {days} days. Continue?

tenancy.denied.title: Access not granted
tenancy.denied.signedInAs: You are signed in as {email}, but this application has not granted you access.
tenancy.denied.unregistered: Your identity was verified, but you do not have a GanttChart account. Accounts are added by an SV of your workspace (or, for a new workspace, by the platform administrator).
tenancy.denied.disabled: Your account has been disabled by an SV.
tenancy.denied.workspace_not_shared: Your workspace is stored locally and is not shared, so Testers cannot open it. Ask an SV to switch it to web storage.
tenancy.panel.title: Workspace
tenancy.panel.name: Workspace
tenancy.panel.localHelp: Your QA data is stored only in this browser. Nobody else can use it, and no members can be added.
tenancy.panel.webHelp: Your QA data is stored in the cloud and shared live with the members you add.
tenancy.panel.deletionBanner: Deletion of this workspace was requested on {when}. A Super Admin will review it. Everything keeps working until then.
tenancy.user.title: Your workspace
tenancy.user.body: You are working in the workspace “{name}” as {role} ({access}).
tenancy.toWeb.title: Move to web storage
tenancy.toWeb.intro: Your data is copied to the cloud, checked there, and only then does the workspace switch to web storage. If anything fails, your local data stays exactly as it is and you can try again.
tenancy.toWeb.inspecting: Checking this browser and the cloud…
tenancy.toWeb.alreadyUploaded: The cloud already contains exactly this data (from an earlier attempt). Finishing will only switch the workspace to web storage.
tenancy.toWeb.needsReplaceTitle: The cloud already contains different data
tenancy.toWeb.needsReplaceBody: Nothing is replaced unless you choose to. Replacing swaps the cloud data for this browser’s data; the cloud data stays in the history for {days} days.
tenancy.toWeb.replaceChoice: Replace the cloud data with this browser’s data
tenancy.toWeb.backupNote: A backup file of this browser’s data is downloaded first.
tenancy.toWeb.done: Done. This workspace now uses web storage. The page will reload.
tenancy.toWeb.unreachable: The cloud could not be reached. Nothing was changed.
tenancy.toWeb.invalidLocal: This browser’s data could not be prepared for upload. Nothing was changed.
tenancy.toLocal.title: Switch to local storage
tenancy.toLocal.warning: Everyone you added will lose access to the shared workspace at once, and their live connections are closed. The cloud copy is kept (archived), not deleted.
tenancy.toLocal.intro: First a complete copy is downloaded, checked and saved in this browser. The switch only happens after that, and only if you confirm.
tenancy.toLocal.prepare: Download and verify a local copy
tenancy.toLocal.prepared: A complete copy ({counts}) was downloaded, saved in this browser and verified.
tenancy.toLocal.done: Done. This workspace now uses local storage. The page will reload.
tenancy.toLocal.changed: The workspace was changed by someone after your copy was made. Nothing was switched. Download a fresh copy and try again.
tenancy.migration.failedIntact: Your local data is untouched and still the authoritative copy. You can try again.
tenancy.migration.step.backup: The backup file could not be created.
tenancy.migration.step.upload: The upload was refused or failed.
tenancy.migration.step.verify: The uploaded data did not pass verification.
tenancy.migration.step.activate: The server refused to switch the workspace.
tenancy.migration.step.save: The local copy could not be saved and verified.
tenancy.users.title: Team Members
tenancy.users.help: Add a member by entering their organization email address and choosing SV or Tester. They sign in later through Cloudflare Access with that same address and enter this workspace automatically; there is no invitation code, password or workspace chooser.
tenancy.users.localOnly: Adding Team Members is available when this workspace uses Web storage. Local storage keeps the data on this browser only, so collaboration with other people is not possible.
tenancy.users.added: Tester {email} was added. They can sign in with that email address.
tenancy.users.disableConfirm: Disable {email}? Their open sessions are closed immediately.
tenancy.users.notDisconnected: The member was disabled, but their live connection could not be closed right now; it ends when their sign-in session expires.
tenancy.error.invalid_email: That email address is not valid.
tenancy.error.invalid_name: That name is not valid (1–80 characters).
tenancy.error.email_taken: That email address is already registered.
tenancy.error.email_reserved: That email address cannot be used.
tenancy.error.wrong_mode: This needs the workspace to use web storage.
tenancy.error.bad_state: That is not possible in the current state.
tenancy.error.forbidden_target: That account cannot be changed this way.
tenancy.error.same_person: You cannot approve your own request.
tenancy.error.forbidden: You are not allowed to do that.
tenancy.error.generic: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed.
tenancy.delete.title: Delete this workspace
tenancy.delete.help: You cannot delete the workspace yourself. As the Owner SV you can request deletion; a Super Admin reviews it and, if they approve, permanently deletes the workspace, all its members and all its data.
tenancy.delete.requestConfirm: Request permanent deletion of this workspace? Nothing is deleted until a Super Admin approves. You can cancel the request.
tenancy.delete.requested: Deletion was requested on {when}. Waiting for Super Admin review.
tenancy.super.title: Platform administration
tenancy.super.subtitle: You see workspace metadata only — never QA data.
tenancy.super.created: Workspace created. {email} can now sign in as its Owner SV, choose local or web storage and add the other members.
tenancy.super.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate “{name}”? All its SVs and Testers are locked out immediately. Nothing is deleted.
tenancy.super.deleteScope: This permanently deletes the workspace “{name}” ({id}): all {users} account(s) in it, and ALL of its QA data, reports, revision history and sync records. This cannot be undone. Only a minimal audit record (who requested, who approved, when) is kept.
tenancy.super.deleteConfirmId: Type the workspace id to confirm
tenancy.super.deleteConfirmEmail: Type the Owner SV’s email address to confirm
tenancy.super.deleteMismatch: The confirmations do not match this workspace. Nothing was deleted.
shared.banner.revokedBody: An SV changed or removed your access to this workspace. Changes you made since the last sync were not saved to the shared workspace. Reload to see what you can access now.
shared.banner.movedTitle: This workspace moved to local storage
shared.banner.movedBody: An SV switched the workspace back to local storage, so the shared workspace is closed. Changes you made since the last sync were not saved. Ask an SV for a copy if you need your data.
shared.banner.deletedBody: This workspace and everything in it was permanently deleted.
landing.title: GanttChart
landing.description: Plan test runs on a Gantt chart, track daily progress and report to your team — in one place for your organization.
landing.signInHelp: You will be asked to verify your identity with your organization email address.
landing.noAccountHelp: Accounts are added by an SV of your workspace. If you cannot sign in, contact them.

tenancy.super.outsideDomainWarning: This identity is outside the currently allowed organization domains and may not be able to authenticate under the current Access policy.

logout.deviceKept: Your data on this device is kept; nothing is deleted.

settings.historyMoved: The revision history now has its own screen: History.

tenancy.lastActivityNote: Last activity is the most recent sign-in, refreshed at most every 12 hours, so it is approximate.

tenancy.storage.local3: Adding Team Members is not available.

tenancy.audit.help: Account and workspace administration only — who created, disabled, reactivated, requested or deleted what. It never contains project or report content, and it is separate from the revision history.
tenancy.users.domainHint: The email address must be in an approved organization domain. A member belongs to this workspace only, permanently; there is no workspace selection.
tenancy.users.emptyBody: Add the first member above. They sign in with their organization email address and work in this workspace.
tenancy.users.noMatch: No members match the search or filter.
tenancy.users.disableBody: {email} will be signed out of the workspace at once and cannot use it until you reactivate the account. Their record and everything they did stay.
tenancy.users.enableBody: {email} will be able to use this workspace again.
tenancy.users.sort.name: Name
tenancy.error.invalid_display_name: That display name is not valid (up to 80 characters, no special characters).
tenancy.delete.requestScope: You are asking the platform administrator to permanently delete the workspace “{name}” with everything in it:
tenancy.delete.requestNothingYet: Nothing is deleted by this request. Everyone keeps working until the platform administrator decides, and you can withdraw the request.
tenancy.super.metadataOnly: This view shows workspace metadata only. QA projects, reports and other workspace content are not available here.
tenancy.super.emptyBody: Create the first workspace. Its first SV becomes the Owner SV, who then chooses local or web storage and adds the team.
tenancy.super.noMatch: No workspace matches the search or filter.
tenancy.super.searchPlaceholder: Workspace, Owner SV email or ID
tenancy.super.createHint: The Owner SV email address must belong to an approved organization domain. No email is sent; the Owner SV simply signs in with that address.
tenancy.super.createdNext: Next: the Owner SV signs in, chooses Local or Web storage and, in Web storage, adds the team members.
tenancy.super.sort.name: Workspace
tenancy.super.disableBody: Every SV and Tester of “{name}” are locked out at once and their open sessions are closed. Nothing is deleted: the data, history and storage stay exactly as they are, and you can reactivate the workspace at any time.
tenancy.super.enableBody: The active SVs and Testers of “{name}” can use the workspace again. No data is changed.
tenancy.super.deletionsHelp: Requests from Owner SVs to delete their workspace permanently. You see metadata only. Approving deletes everything; rejecting simply leaves the workspace as it is.
tenancy.super.rejectBody: The workspace becomes active again, exactly as before. Nothing was deleted. The Owner SV can ask again later.
tenancy.super.rejectDone: The deletion request for “{name}” was rejected.
tenancy.super.deleteItem1: the workspace and its workspace data
tenancy.super.deleteItem6: any other data owned by the workspace
tenancy.super.ov.capped: Counts cover the {shown} newest of {total} workspaces; use the Workspaces tab to search all.
tenancy.super.ov.deletionNote: {count} deletion request(s) are waiting for a decision.
tenancy.super.ov.outsideNote: {count} workspace(s) have an Owner SV outside the allowed organization domains.

dashboard.empty.title: This workspace has no projects yet
dashboard.empty.admin: Create the first project in Projects / Test Executions. In Web storage you can add your team on the Team Members screen.
dashboard.empty.editor: Nothing has been set up here yet. You can create the first project in Projects / Test Executions.
dashboard.empty.viewer: Nothing has been set up here yet. You have read-only access, so projects appear here once an SV creates them.
tenancy.error.tester_duplicate: That email address is already registered in this workspace. Nothing was added.
tenancy.error.email_in_other_workspace: That email address already belongs to another workspace, so it cannot be added here. It was not moved or duplicated, and nothing was changed.
qa.executedHint: Executed = Passed + Failed: the cases that produced a verdict.
qa.blockedHint: Blocked is an open status: those cases are neither executed nor completed and stay in Remaining until they are.
qa.completionHint: Completed (Passed + Failed + N/A + SPO) divided by Planned.
qa.passRateHint: Passed divided by Executed (Passed + Failed). Shown as — until something has been executed.
qa.warning.completed_exceeds_planned: Completed cases are above the planned total. The history is kept; check the planned total or the daily entries.
qa.warning.breakdown_exceeds_completed: Passed + Failed + N/A + SPO is larger than the completed total; check the daily entries.
risk.behind_plan: Behind plan (at risk or short of capacity)
risk.schedule_attention: Needs attention on schedule (deadline within a week, or no update for two weeks)
risk.due_soon_much_remaining: Deadline in {value} day(s) with more than 20% of the cases still open
risk.completed_exceeds_planned: Completed cases are above the planned total
risk.cycle_overdue: The cycle’s planned end has passed
risk.cycle_due_soon_much_remaining: The cycle ends in {value} day(s) with more than 20% of the cases still open
risk.projects_need_attention: {value} execution(s) in this cycle need attention
cycles.title: Cycles
cycles.help: A cycle groups the test executions of one release or verification round. A test execution belongs to at most one cycle, and works fine without one.
cycles.readonlyNote: Only an SV can change cycles. You can read everything here.
cycles.unassignedProjects: {count} test execution(s) are not in any cycle.
cycles.missing: {count} test execution(s) refer to a cycle that does not exist. Nothing was changed; ask an SV to put them in a cycle.
cycles.empty.title: No cycles yet
cycles.empty.body: Create the first cycle (for example “Android 4.2.0 Release”), then add test executions to it.
cycles.empty.bodyReadonly: An SV has not created any cycle yet. Test executions are still available under Projects / Test Executions.
cycles.col.name: Cycle
cycles.confirm.completed.title: Complete “{name}”?
cycles.confirm.completed.body: The cycle is marked completed today. Its test executions and results stay exactly as they are, and you can reopen it later.
cycles.confirm.archived.title: Archive “{name}”?
cycles.confirm.archived.body: An archived cycle takes no new test executions and is left out of the dashboard choices. Nothing is deleted, and you can restore it.
cycles.form.name: Cycle name
cycles.error.cycle_invalid_name: Enter a cycle name (up to 120 characters).
cycles.error.cycle_invalid_date: That is not a real calendar date.
cycles.error.cycle_end_before_start: The planned end is before the planned start.
cycles.error.cycle_invalid_version: The release / version label is too long (up to 60 characters).
cycles.error.cycle_invalid_description: The description is too long (up to 2000 characters).
cycles.error.cycle_not_found: That cycle does not exist in this workspace.
cycles.error.cycle_archived: An archived cycle takes no new test executions. Restore it first.
cycles.error.cycle_transition_not_allowe: That change of status is not possible from the current status.
cycles.error.generic: The cycle could not be saved. Nothing was changed.
cycles.detail.noProjects: No test executions in this cycle yet.
cycles.detail.removed: “{name}” was taken out of the cycle.
cycles.detail.noTesters: Nobody is assigned to the test executions of this cycle.
cycles.detail.noRecent: No results were recorded in the last 7 days.
mgr.title: QA manager overview
mgr.results: Aggregate execution metrics (active executions, from the daily entries)
mgr.noResultsToday: No results have been recorded for today yet.
cc.title: Test execution control center
cc.accountsNeedWeb: Assigning Tester accounts needs Web storage. Team members can still be assigned in Performance.
cc.assignError.tester_disabled: That Tester is disabled and cannot be newly assigned. Reactivate the account first.
cc.assignError.tester_not_found: That Tester is not part of this workspace.
cc.assignError.project_not_found: That test execution is not in this workspace yet. Wait for it to sync and try again.
cc.assignError.forbidden: Only an SV can assign Testers.
cc.assignError.generic: The Tester could not be assigned. Nothing was changed.
workload.title: Tester workload
workload.help: Who is on which active test execution. “Shared remaining” counts the remaining cases of each assigned execution in full: where several people share one, nothing is divided, because the data has no weighting.
workload.allAssigned: Every active execution has someone assigned.
report.exec.none: No execution results were recorded for this day.
report.exec.risk.due_soon_much_remaining: deadline close with many cases open
tenancy.users.addedSv: SV {email} was added. They can sign in with that email address.
tenancy.users.roleHelpSv: An SV manages the whole workspace: projects, plans, cycles, members and settings.
tenancy.users.roleHelpTester: A Tester enters their own results, tickets and performance, and can view the plan.
team.members.title: Team Members
tenancy.owner.transferBody: {email} becomes the Owner SV of this workspace. Only the Owner SV can ask for the workspace to be deleted or hand over the ownership.
tenancy.owner.transferKeeps: You stay an SV with full access. Nothing else changes, and nothing is deleted.
tenancy.error.owner_protected: The Owner SV cannot be disabled or changed. Transfer the ownership first.
tenancy.error.invalid_role: That role is not valid. Choose SV or Tester.
tenancy.error.user_not_found: That member was not found in this workspace.
tenancy.error.member_not_found: That roster member was not found.
tenancy.error.member_already_linked: That roster member is already linked to an account.
tenancy.error.account_already_linked: That account already has a profile.
tenancy.error.invalid_user_id: That member id is not valid.
tenancy.error.invalid_member_id: That roster member id is not valid.
team.myProfile.title: My Team Member Profile
team.myProfile.help: This is how you appear in this workspace. Your SVs manage members; you only see yourself here.
team.myProfile.name: Display name
team.myProfile.notLinked: Your account is not linked to a Team Member profile yet, so you cannot enter your own performance rows. Ask an SV to link it.
team.myProfile.assigned: Test executions you are assigned to
team.myProfile.assignedNone: You are not assigned to any test execution yet.
team.myProfile.readOnlyNote: Your email address, role and workspace are set by your SVs and cannot be changed here.
settings.dataBackup.title: Data & Backup
settings.dataBackup.help: Export the project on screen to a file, import a file, or reset it to the demo data. Importing and resetting replace the project’s data and ask you to confirm first.
dashboard.testerReadOnlyInputs: The project inputs are set by an SV. You can enter Today’s Execution below.
gantt.testerReadOnly: The plan is set by an SV. You can view it here.
performance.testerNoProfile: Your account is not linked to a Team Member profile yet. Ask an SV to link it before you enter your performance.
settings.appearance.title: Workspace Appearance
settings.appearance.help: Give this workspace its own name for the tool. Everyone in the workspace sees it after signing in. The public sign-in page keeps the platform name.
settings.appearance.cleared: The platform name is shown again.
settings.appearance.invalid: The tool name must be 1–{max} characters of plain text (no < or >).
settings.appearance.logoNote: A workspace logo is not available yet.
jira.title: JIRA Integration
jira.help: Import issues from an Atlassian JIRA instance (Cloud or Data Center) by JQL. The connection is stored in this browser only: it is not synced, backed up or shared.
jira.tokenHint: Cloud: Atlassian API token. Data Center: Personal Access Token. Stored in this browser only.
jira.tokenSaved: A token is saved. It is never shown again — type a new value to replace it.
jira.proxyHint: JIRA Cloud does not allow direct browser calls (CORS), so Cloud integrations need a small proxy (for example a Cloudflare Worker) that forwards requests. When set, the app calls the proxy with the original JIRA path instead of calling JIRA directly.
jira.baseUrlInvalid: Enter a full address starting with https:// (or http://).
jira.proxyUrlInvalid: The proxy address must start with https:// (or http://).
jira.proxyInsecure: This proxy uses plain http://, so the token travels unencrypted. Use https:// unless the proxy is on this computer.
jira.warning: Security note: the token is stored in plain text in this browser's local storage. Anyone with access to this computer or browser profile can read it. Use a token with the least privileges needed, and avoid shared devices.
jira.error.notConfigured: Not configured: enter the base URL and the credentials for the selected type.
jira.error.auth: Authentication failed. Check the email and API token (Cloud) or Personal Access Token (Data Center).
jira.error.forbidden: Access denied. The account may not have permission to search issues.
jira.error.rateLimit: JIRA is rate-limiting requests. Wait a moment, then try again.
jira.error.timeout: The request timed out. Check the connection and the proxy settings.
jira.error.network: Network error. Check the connection and that the site is reachable.
jira.error.cors: The browser blocked the request (CORS). JIRA does not allow direct browser calls by default — if JIRA opens in a browser tab, this is the cause. Set a Proxy URL (above) that forwards to JIRA.
jira.error.badRequest: JIRA rejected the request (invalid JQL or request parameters).
jira.error.server: JIRA server error. Try again later.
testrail.title: TestRail Integration
testrail.help: Fetch each tester's daily execution results from a TestRail plan or test run (API key, read-only). The connection is stored in this browser only: it is not synced, backed up or shared.
testrail.apiKeyHint: Generated in TestRail under My Settings → API Keys. Sent as HTTP Basic auth with the email above; stored in this browser only.
testrail.apiKeySaved: An API key is saved. It is never shown again — type a new value to replace it.
testrail.apiKeyRemoved: The saved API key was removed.
testrail.proxyHint: TestRail does not allow direct browser calls (CORS), so a small proxy (for example a Cloudflare Worker) that forwards requests is effectively required. When set, the app calls the proxy with the original TestRail path instead of calling TestRail directly.
testrail.baseUrlInvalid: Enter a full address starting with https:// (or http://).
testrail.proxyUrlInvalid: The proxy address must start with https:// (or http://).
testrail.proxyInsecure: This proxy uses plain http://, so the API key travels unencrypted. Use https:// unless the proxy is on this computer.
testrail.warning: Security note: the API key is stored in plain text in this browser's local storage. Anyone with access to this computer or browser profile can read it. Use a key with the least privileges needed, and avoid shared devices.
testrail.error.notConfigured: Not configured: enter the base URL, the email and the API key.
testrail.error.auth: Authentication failed. Check the email and the API key (TestRail: My Settings → API Keys).
testrail.error.forbidden: Access denied. The account may not have permission to read this TestRail data.
testrail.error.rateLimit: TestRail is rate-limiting requests. Wait a moment, then try again.
testrail.error.timeout: The request timed out. Check the connection and the proxy settings.
testrail.error.network: Network error. Check the connection and that the instance is reachable.
testrail.error.cors: The browser blocked the request (CORS). TestRail does not allow direct browser calls — set a Proxy URL (Settings → TestRail Integration) that forwards to TestRail.
testrail.error.badRequest: TestRail rejected the request (invalid plan/run or parameters).
testrail.error.server: TestRail server error. Try again later.
exec.testrailLinkInvalid: Paste a TestRail plan or run URL (…/plans/view/123 or …/runs/view/123).
exec.testrailLinkHostMismatch: This URL points to a different TestRail instance than the configured connection.
exec.testrailLockedHint: This project is linked to TestRail: the status counts come from the TestRail fetch (or a CSV import) for the selected day and cannot be typed by hand. Unlink to edit them manually.
exec.testrailFetched: TestRail {date}: {executed} result(s) by {testers} tester(s) loaded below — review and Save.
exec.testrailNoResults: No TestRail results for {date}. Nothing was changed.
exec.testrailUnassigned: {count} result(s) had no assigned tester — they are counted in the totals only.
exec.testrailKeptManual: {count} existing manual record(s) were kept (not overwritten).
exec.testrailCsvLoaded: {file}: {executed} result(s) by {testers} tester(s) loaded below — review and Save.
exec.testrailCsvFailed: No TestRail results could be read from {file}. Check that it is a CSV with the expected columns (Tester, Tested, …) or a TestRail results export.
exec.testrailCsvRowErrors: {count} row(s) were skipped. Please review the file.
jira.import.title: Import Test Cases from JIRA
jira.import.help: Run a JQL search, preview the issues as Test Cases, then import them into the selected scope. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
jira.import.jqlHelp: A JIRA query. Replace the placeholder project key with a real one, e.g. project = DEMO AND type = Bug ORDER BY updated DESC.
jira.import.notConfigured: JIRA is not set up yet. Open Settings → JIRA Integration and add the base URL, credentials and (for Cloud) a proxy URL first.
jira.import.counts: {duplicates} duplicate(s) and {invalid} issue(s) without a title will be skipped.
jira.import.noneImportable: Nothing to import: every issue is a duplicate or has no title. Change the JQL and fetch again.
jira.import.done: {count} test case(s) were imported from JIRA.
jira.import.doneSkipped: {duplicates} duplicate(s) and {invalid} issue(s) without a title were skipped.
jira.import.blocking.title: Import Blocking Events from JIRA
jira.import.blocking.minutesEach: Minutes lost per ticket (you can edit each row afterwards)
jira.import.blocking.help: Each issue becomes a blocking event on {date} (default: today). Adjust the date, category and minutes, remove what does not belong, then apply. Re-importing the same issue on the same date is skipped.
jira.import.blocking.rows: {count} blocking event(s) will be added for {date}.
jira.import.blocking.done: {imported} blocking event(s) were added; {skipped} duplicate(s) were skipped.
tm.testrailImport.title: Import TestRail Runs as Scopes
tm.testrailImport.help: Paste a TestRail plan URL to see its runs. Tick the runs to add as Test Scopes: each becomes one scope with its Total Test Cases and a live TestRail link. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
tm.testrailImport.planUrlHelp: A plan URL looks like …/index.php?/plans/view/123 — its runs are the import candidates. A standalone run URL (…/runs/view/…) imports that single run.
tm.testrailImport.invalidPlanUrl: That is not a TestRail plan or run URL (…/plans/view/123 or …/runs/view/123).
tm.testrailImport.notConfigured: TestRail is not set up yet. Open Settings → TestRail Integration and add the base URL, the email and the API key (plus a proxy URL if the browser blocks direct calls) first.
tm.testrailImport.duplicatesSkipped: {count} run(s) already linked by a scope of this project will be skipped.
tm.testrailImport.selectHelp: Tick the runs to add. Skipped runs are shown for reference only and can never be duplicated.
tm.testrailImport.noneSelectable: Nothing to add: every run is already linked by a scope of this project.
tm.testrailImport.assignHelp: The imported runs' assigned TestRail testers were matched to Team Members by email. Confirm to assign them to their scopes — the Testers column and the Overview tab update immediately. TestRail users without a matching Team Member are listed for you to assign by hand.
tm.testrailImport.assignNone: No run tester matched a Team Member — nothing to assign automatically.
tm.testrailImport.assignUnmatched: {count} TestRail tester(s) matched no Team Member — link them to a member so their assignments are created:
tm.testrailImport.assignUnmatchedHint: {count} TestRail tester(s) matched no Team Member — assign them by hand in the Scopes tab.
tm.testrailCases.title: Import Test Cases from TestRail
tm.testrailCases.help: Fetches the cases of the linked run's suite and imports them as Test Cases of this scope. Each imported case keeps its TestRail case id, so the Execution tab can sync results later. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
tm.testrailCases.notConfigured: TestRail is not set up yet. Open Settings → TestRail Integration first.
tm.testrailCases.noLink: This scope is not linked to a TestRail run. Import the scope from TestRail (Scopes tab) or link a run first.
tm.testrailCases.noSuite: The linked run exposes no suite id, so its cases cannot be listed. Use a run created from a suite.
tm.testrailCases.counts: {duplicates} duplicate(s) and {invalid} case(s) without a title will be skipped.
tm.testrailCases.noneImportable: Nothing to import: every case is a duplicate or has no title.
tm.testrailCases.done: {count} test case(s) were imported from TestRail.
tm.testrailCases.doneSkipped: {duplicates} duplicate(s) and {invalid} case(s) without a title were skipped.
tm.execSync.notConfigured: To sync results, configure the TestRail connection in Settings first.
tm.execSync.noLinkedScopes: No scope shown is linked to a TestRail run. Link one in Scopes first.
tm.execSync.title: Sync results from TestRail
tm.execSync.help: The linked runs' current test statuses are matched to the registered Test Cases (by their TestRail case id). Only cases whose status would change are listed — confirm to apply them.
tm.execSync.statusLine: Pass {pass} · Fail {fail} · Blocked {blocked} · In progress {inProgress} · Not started {notStarted}
tm.execSync.customStatuses: {count} case(s) use a custom TestRail status and map to In progress.
tm.execSync.unmatched: {count} test(s) of the runs have no registered Test Case (import the cases first).
tm.execSync.done: {count} case result(s) were updated from TestRail.
tm.execSync.noChanges: Everything already matches TestRail — no changes needed.
tm.testrailProgress.line: {passed} Passed, {blocked} Blocked, {retest} Retest, {failed} Failed, {untested} Untested · {pct}% passed
tm.testrailProgress.notConfigured: TestRail is not connected on this device. Set it up in Settings → TestRail Integration to see live run progress.
tm.testrailProgress.tester.line: {name}: {passed} Passed, {blocked} Blocked, {retest} Retest, {failed} Failed, {untested} Untested · {pct}% passed
jira.tab.title: JIRA Tickets
jira.tab.noMembers: No team members in this workspace.
jira.tab.unmatchedTitle: JIRA reporters not on the team
jira.tab.noUnmatched: Every reporter was matched to a team member.
jira.tab.fetchCapNote: JIRA returned the maximum of 500 tickets. Narrow the period or the project scope to see everything.
jira.tab.notConfigured: JIRA is not configured. Open Settings → JIRA Integration to connect an instance.
jira.tab.noMappedProjects: No project has a JIRA project key yet. Set the keys in the Project JIRA mapping section below, then fetch the tickets.
jira.tab.noMappedProjectsTester: No project has a JIRA project key yet, so there is nothing to fetch. Ask the SV to map the projects.
jira.tab.fetchHint: Choose the filters above and press Fetch tickets.
jira.tab.staleResults: The filters changed since the last fetch. Fetch again to refresh the results.
jira.tab.csvLoaded: {file}: {count} ticket(s) loaded (the filters above are not applied).
jira.tab.csvFailed: No tickets could be read from {file}. Check that it is a JIRA CSV export (with Issue key and Summary columns) or this tab's CSV export.
jira.tab.csvRowErrors: {count} row(s) were skipped. Please review the file.
jira.tab.mappingHelp: Each project's JIRA project key (for example PROJ for tickets PROJ-123) connects that project's tickets to this workspace and to this tab.
jira.tab.projectKeyInvalid: Use only A-Z and 0-9, starting with a letter (e.g. PROJ).
jira.tab.noResultsExport: Fetch tickets first — there is nothing to export yet.
jira.tab.mappingNoProjects: No projects yet. Create a project first.
jira.importTickets.title: Import to Tickets
jira.importTickets.hint: Write the fetched tickets into the matching projects' Tickets lists; the Performance tab counts them automatically.
jira.importTickets.reasonFetch: Fetch tickets first — there is nothing to import yet.
jira.importTickets.idempotent: Importing again updates already-present tickets in place — nothing is duplicated.
jira.importTickets.totals: {tickets} ticket(s) will be imported into {projects} project(s); {skipped} skipped.
jira.importTickets.unroutableTitle: These tickets could not be routed
jira.importTickets.reasonNoProjectKey: Set this project's JIRA key in the mapping section below.
jira.importTickets.reasonNoVersionMatch: The affected version doesn't match the project cycle (candidates: {candidates}).
jira.importTickets.noneRoutable: Nothing to import — every ticket was skipped.
jira.importTickets.openTickets: Open the Tickets tab to review the imported tickets — the Performance tab counts them automatically.
newProject.jiraProjectKeyHint: Connects this project's tickets on the JIRA tab (e.g. PROJ).
exec.notAssigned: You are not assigned to this test execution, so you cannot record its results. Ask an SV to assign you.
shared.banner.errorWhy: Your change was not saved to the shared workspace: {reason}
shared.reject.tester_cannot_change_kind: Testers cannot change this kind of record.

shared.reject.tester_project_plan: Testers cannot change a project’s plan or totals.
shared.reject.tester_execution_not_today: Testers can record today’s execution only.

shared.reject.tester_performance_not_own: You can change only your own performance rows.
shared.reject.tester_not_linked: Your account is not linked to a Team Member profile yet. Ask an SV to link it.
shared.reject.member_link_requires_api: The link between a profile and an account can only be set from Team Members.
tester.profileNotLinked.title: Your Team Member profile has not been linked yet
tester.profileNotLinked.body: Your account is active, but your Team Member profile has not been linked yet. Please ask an SV to complete the Team Member setup. Until then you can raise tickets, but you cannot enter performance rows.
tm.title: Test Management
tm.noProjects: There are no projects yet. Create one in Projects / Test Executions first.
tm.col.title: Title
tm.col.question: Question
tm.field.scopeCodeHelp: Letters and digits, e.g. ECO. Used to suggest case keys like ECO-001. Renaming the scope later never changes existing case keys.
tm.scope.archiveBody: Its test cases and results stay as history, but nobody can record new results in it, and it is left out of the project totals. You can reactivate it later.
tm.scope.help: A scope is a part of the test execution, such as Ecosystem, HTMA or VVM. Test cases belong to exactly one scope.
tm.case.truncated: {count} more test case(s) are not shown here; use the filters in Execution to find them.
tm.bulk.help: Copy cells from Excel and paste them here: one case per line, columns Key, Title, Priority, Type, Expected Result (only Title is needed; a blank Key gets the next free key). Nothing is saved until the whole paste is valid and you confirm.
tm.bulk.placeholder: ECO-001	Login with existing account	High	Functional	User reaches Home
tm.bulk.valid: {count} test case(s) are ready to add.
tm.bulk.nothingSaved: Nothing was added. Fix the lines above and check again.
tm.bulk.err.bulk_invalid_key: The key “{value}” is not valid (letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore; up to 40 characters).
tm.bulk.err.bulk_duplicate_key_in_paste: The key “{value}” appears twice in the paste.
tm.bulk.err.bulk_key_exists: The key “{value}” already exists in this project.
tm.bulk.err.bulk_title_too_long: The title is too long (200 characters at most).
tm.bulk.err.bulk_invalid_priority: The priority “{value}” is not valid (Critical, High, Medium or Low).
tm.bulk.err.bulk_text_too_long: The type or expected result is too long.
tm.bulk.err.bulk_too_many_rows: Too many lines: paste at most {value} at a time.
tm.assign.done: The Tester was assigned to the scope.
tm.empty.noScopes: No test scopes have been created for this project yet.
tm.empty.noCases: No test cases have been added to this scope yet. Use Add Test Case or Bulk Add.
tm.empty.noTesters: No Testers are assigned to this scope.
tm.overview.title: Scopes of this test execution
tm.overview.sourceNote: The Total Test Cases is typed by an SV and is the size used everywhere. The detailed numbers below describe only the Test Cases registered here; they are never added to the daily execution totals of the Dashboard, Cycles and the Daily Report.
tm.exec.title: Execution
tm.exec.noCases: There are no test cases to execute here yet.
tm.exec.noMatch: No test cases match the filters.
tm.analysis.title: TestRail Result Analysis
tm.analysis.empty: Import a TestRail Test Results export (CSV) or fetch the results of this project's linked runs, then the quality checks run automatically.
tm.analysis.csvRowErrors: {count} rows were skipped (unknown status or date).
tm.analysis.noLinkedRuns: No scope of this project links a TestRail run yet. Link one in Scopes first.
tm.analysis.apiEmpty: The linked runs returned no results.
tm.analysis.noConnection: To fetch live, configure the TestRail connection in Settings first.
tm.analysis.apiNoSteps: Data fetched from the API has no step-level statuses, so the Untested check does not run. Import the CSV export for that check.
tm.analysis.noBuilds: No Build names found in comments.
tm.analysis.unknownStatusesHint: Those rows are kept as Custom Status, like TestRail treats status ids ≥ 6.
tm.sum.title: Detailed execution of the registered Test Cases
tm.sum.question: Question
tm.my.title: My Testing
tm.my.none: You do not currently have any assigned test scopes.
tm.error.generic: That could not be done. Nothing was changed.
tm.error.scope_invalid_name: Enter a scope name (up to 80 characters).
tm.error.scope_invalid_code: The short code may use letters, digits, dash and underscore (up to 12 characters).
tm.error.scope_code_taken: Another scope of this project already uses that code.
tm.error.testcase_invalid_key: The case key is not valid (letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore).
tm.error.testcase_key_taken: That case key is already used in this project.
tm.error.tester_disabled: That Tester is disabled and cannot be assigned.
tm.error.tester_not_found: That Tester was not found in this workspace.
tm.error.forbidden: Only an SV can do that.
tenancy.legacy.title: Old placeholder members
tenancy.legacy.body: This workspace still has placeholder members from the old default roster. {remove} that nothing refers to can be removed; {retire} that history refers to will be kept for the history but made inactive. Real people are added in Add Member.
tenancy.legacy.confirmTitle: Clean up the old placeholder members?
tenancy.legacy.confirmBody: {remove} placeholder member(s) will be removed and {retire} will be made inactive (they stay in the history). Nothing else changes, and nobody is turned into a real account.
tm.total.title: Total Test Cases
tm.total.help: Total Test Cases is the business total, typed by an SV. Registered Test Cases are the detailed cases created here; there may be fewer. Registering cases never changes the Total.
tm.total.invalid: Enter a whole number, 0 or more.
tm.total.fromScopes: Calculated from the Total Test Cases of this project's scopes (Test Management > Scopes).
tm.total.projectOwn: No scope has a Total yet, so this project's own Total Test Cases ({total}) is used. Set a Total on a scope to calculate the project total from its scopes.
tm.total.missing: {count} scope(s) have no Total Test Cases and count as 0.
tm.total.warnOver: {registered} active Test Cases are registered, but Total Test Cases is set to {total}.
tm.total.warnOverHint: Raise the Total, archive cases, or leave it for now. Nothing is changed automatically.
tm.overview.detailNote: Based only on the {registered} registered Test Cases. Cases that are not registered have no result here, so this is not the overall progress.
tm.error.scope_invalid_total: Total Test Cases must be a whole number, 0 or more.
tm.error.scope_invalid_testrail: The TestRail link is not valid.
tm.error.testcase_invalid_testrail_case: The TestRail case link is not valid.
tm.total.warnOverScopes: Some scopes have more registered Test Cases than their Total Test Cases (see the Scopes tab).
dir.help: Team Members is the one list of people in this workspace. Everyone you pick on any screen comes from here. A person can exist without a login; create the login now or later.
dir.name: Display name
dir.emailHint: Optional for a profile. Needed to create a login, and unique within this workspace.
dir.loginNone: Profile only (no login yet; it can be created later)
dir.addedProfile: {name} was added as a Team Member without a login.
dir.addedLogin: {name} was added with a login ({email}). They can sign in with that address.
dir.localNote: This workspace uses Local storage, so people here are profiles only. Logins need Web storage.
dir.empty: No Team Members yet. Add the first one above.
dir.unlinkedExplain: A person without a login can be chosen and assigned, but cannot sign in or record results until a login is linked.
dir.ownerProtected: The Owner SV cannot be removed or demoted. Transfer the ownership first.
dir.edit.title: Edit profile
dir.edit.emailLocked: The email follows the login and cannot be edited here.
dir.role.title: Change the role of {name}?
dir.role.bodySv: {name} becomes an SV: full management of projects, plans, members and settings.
dir.role.bodyTester: {name} becomes a Tester: they enter their own results, tickets and performance, and can view the plan.
dir.role.bodyLinked: The login changes now and any open session is ended; they sign back in with the new permissions. Past records keep the role they were made under.
dir.role.bodyUnlinked: This sets the intended role. It applies when a login is created.
dir.role.notClosed: The role was changed, but their live connection could not be closed right now; it ends at the next sign-in check.
dir.remove.title: Remove {name}?
dir.remove.bodyLinked: Their login ({email}) is disabled in the same action and their open sessions end. They disappear from new assignment lists. All their history stays, and you can reactivate them later.
dir.remove.bodyUnlinked: They disappear from new assignment lists. All their history stays, and you can reactivate them later.
dir.reactivate.title: Reactivate {name}?
dir.reactivate.body: {name} is a Team Member again and appears in assignment lists.
dir.reactivate.loginBody: Their login ({email}) is still disabled. Re-enable it so they can sign in again?
dir.reactivate.loginKept: {name} was reactivated; the login is still disabled.
dir.login.created: A login was created for {name} ({email}). The existing profile was linked; no duplicate was made.
dir.login.createdAssignments: {count} assignment(s) are now usable by their login.
dir.login.needsEmail: Add an email to this profile first; the login is created for that address.
dir.login.linked: {name} is now linked to the login {email}.
dir.login.removedFirst: This person was removed. Reactivate them first.
po.title: Project Owners
po.help: Which person owns each project. Assignee names are entered freely; once registered, a name can be reused for other projects instead of being typed again.
po.assigneeHint: Assignees already registered are suggested. One person can own several projects.
po.deleteBody: Only the registry row is removed. Projects already created keep their Project Owner.
po.empty: No Project Owners registered yet. Register the first one above.
po.added: {assignee} was registered as the Project Owner of {project}.
po.updated: The Project Owner of {project} was updated.
po.removed: {project} was removed from the Project Owner registry.
tenancy.error.member_email_taken: Another Team Member in this workspace already has that email.
tenancy.error.member_email_locked: This profile has a login, so its email follows the login and cannot be changed here.
tenancy.error.member_email_mismatch: This profile has a different email than the login, so they cannot be linked.
tenancy.error.member_inactive: This Team Member is removed. Reactivate them first.
tenancy.error.member_removed: A removed Team Member has that email. Reactivate them instead of adding again.
tenancy.error.member_not_tester: Only a Tester can be assigned to test work.
tenancy.error.member_linked: This Team Member already has a login. Assign the login instead.
tenancy.error.email_required_for_account: An email is needed to create a login.
tenancy.error.role_required_for_account: Choose SV or Tester for this person before creating a login.
tenancy.error.invalid_team: That team name is not valid.
tenancy.error.archived: The workspace is archived and cannot be changed.
tenancy.error.scope_not_found: That scope was not found in this project.
shared.banner.roleChangedBody: An SV changed your role. Reload to continue with your new permissions.
tenancy.audit.action.member.account_link: Login linked to a Team Member
mt.title: Team Meeting
mt.svOnly: The team meeting is presented by an SV.
mt.empty: There are no active projects to present today.
mt.unplanned: {count} project(s) have no plan for today yet.
mt.scopeNote: Scope rows show the plan and who is assigned. Results are recorded per project, so the day's actual, Pass, Fail and Blocked appear on the project row.
mt.error.invalid: Enter a whole number, 0 or more.
risk.below_plan: Today's actual is {value} below the plan
risk.no_plan_set: No plan is set for today
mt.tomorrow.title: Tomorrow's Schedule - {date}
mt.tomorrow.help: Prepare tomorrow's plan here. It appears in tomorrow's Morning Meeting without being entered again, and can be changed there.
mt.note.title: Meeting notes
mt.note.placeholder: A short note for the team
mt.confirmHelp: Keeps today's plan as the Morning target. The Evening compares the actual against it, even if the plan is changed later.
mt.confirmed: Today's plan was confirmed as the Morning target.
mt.detail.coverageNote: detail only; the totals above come from the Total Test Cases and the daily execution.
mt.gantt.title: Schedule
mt.gantt.hint: Each bar runs from the project's start to its deadline; the filled part is the share completed of the Total Test Cases.
mt.diffNote: Difference = Today's Actual - Today's Plan, over all projects shown. A project with no results recorded today counts as 0 actual.
nt.title: Notifications
nt.ackFailed: Could not save that you closed this. It stays here; try again.
nt.help: Scheduled reminders shown inside the application. Each person closes their own; closing one does not hide it for anyone else, and the next occurrence appears again. Times are business time (Asia/Tokyo). If someone is away, only the latest due occurrence is shown to them.
nt.needsWeb: Notifications are available when this workspace uses Web storage and you are an SV: they depend on signed-in Team Members.
nt.deleteBody: It stops appearing for everyone and its acknowledgments are removed. Switch it off instead to keep it for later.
nt.empty: No notifications yet. Add the first one above.
nt.f.title: Title
nt.f.plainText: Plain text only; line breaks are kept.
nt.f.monthlyRule: In a month without that day (for example the 31st), the last day of the month is used.
nt.f.yearlyRule: A 29 February notification falls on 28 February in years that have no 29 February.
nt.f.unlinkedNote: People without a login can be chosen, but can only close a notification once they have a login.
nt.error.generic: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed.
nt.error.notification_member_not_found: A chosen Team Member is not in this workspace.
nt.error.notification_invalid_message: The message is too long or has unsupported characters.
nt.error.notification_invalid_weekdays: Choose at least one day of the week.
nt.error.notification_invalid_audience: Choose who it is for (and at least one person for Specific Members).
nt.error.notification_invalid_date: The dates are not valid (the last day cannot be before the first).
nt.error.not_addressed: That notification is not addressed to you.
nt.error.invalid_occurrence: That occurrence is not due or does not exist.
branding.help: Your workspace logo is shown after sign-in in the application header and in the meeting view. The public sign-in page keeps the platform branding.
branding.none: No logo set; the default is used.
branding.formats: Supported: {types}. The picture is shrunk to at most {side} px and stored at up to {kb} KB. SVG is not supported.
branding.removed: The logo was removed; the default is used again. The Tool Name is unchanged.
branding.error.generic: The logo could not be saved. Nothing was changed.
branding.error.type: Invalid image: use a PNG, JPEG or WebP file.
branding.error.logo_invalid_type: Invalid image: use a PNG, JPEG or WebP file.
branding.error.logo_type_mismatch: Invalid image: the file is not the type it claims to be.
branding.error.logo_invalid_data: Invalid image: the file could not be read.
branding.error.unreadable: Invalid image: the file could not be read.
branding.error.tooLarge: Image too large, even after shrinking. Use a smaller picture.
branding.error.logo_too_large: Image too large, even after shrinking. Use a smaller picture.
retention.title: Data Retention
retention.help: Meeting plans and notes older than this are removed automatically (checked at most once a day). Today and future plans are never removed. The revision History, test cases, projects and the administrative audit are not affected.
retention.plans: Keep meeting plans and notes for
retention.note: Shortening this removes older days at the next daily check.
mth.title: Meeting History
mth.help: A past day as it was stored: the plan, the results recorded, the notes and the plan made for the next business day. This is the business view over dates; the technical revision History is separate.
mth.retainedUntil: Meeting history is kept from {date} (the last {days} days).
mth.outside: This day is outside the retention period (kept from {date}), so its plan and notes are no longer available.
mth.empty: Nothing was stored for this day.
mth.scopeNoActual: Results are recorded per project; there is no actual for a scope.
mth.storedNote: Plan, results and notes are the stored values of that day. Remaining at end of day is measured against the current Total Test Cases. Who was assigned that day is not stored, so no assignees are shown.
mth.rangeEmpty: No stored days in the last two weeks up to this date.
mth.diffNote: Difference = Actual - Plan, over all projects shown. A project with a plan and no results recorded counts as 0 actual.
